source_semantics.HIL-NFR-28: For each active requirement in the specified target scope, bind six stated conditions individually and keep unresolved ambiguity/orphan/stale not green. Service/capability may have a reasoned non-applicability.
source_semantics.HIL-FR-45: Preserve thirteen semantic fields with typed edges; split/merge/rename/supersede/reject/N/A each require complete before/after digest, all source atom dispositions, downstream stale/result, and review-authority receipt.
source_semantics.difference: The sources are compatible when NFR-28 justified service/capability non-applicability is preserved as a supported value within the required field, not as field omission or a requirement-change operation. The selected source pair does not establish general field-value non-applicability for the other twelve fields; retain their required meaning and values. Any separately evidenced field-specific non-applicability must be documented with its own source, scope, revision, authority/applicability basis and cannot waive owner/source/oracle or other relation fields. The independent PO choice is whether to retain this source-faithful candidate interpretation for service/capability (A), defer the NFR-28 clause as unrepresented under strict 078-001 reading (B), or request an explicit meaning decision (C). FR-45 itself does not prohibit field-value N/A in the abstract; it explicitly gates N/A when used as a listed requirement-change operation.

options.A: Recommended: retain capability/service as a required field and permit only NFR-28’s explicit reasoned non-applicability value for that field when scope, revision, authority/applicability basis and typed relation are present; other twelve fields retain required meaning/values unless a separate field-specific source explicitly supports an exception; omission/unknown remains incomplete, and FR-45 requirement-change N/A keeps its full separate receipt.
options.B: Keep 078-001’s strict interpretation; preserve NFR-28 in source holding and leave its service/capability non-applicability clause unresolved rather than claiming candidate coverage.
options.C: If the PO considers these requirements semantically incompatible, defer adoption and return an explicit meaning-change decision for the two exact source revisions; do not silently drop either clause.

po_decision_material.recommendation: A, because NFR-28 expressly allows a reasoned non-applicability for service/capability, while FR-45 requires semantic fields/typed relations and separately receipt-gates listed change operations. Preserve that field with an evidence-bound value; do not infer field deletion, generalize the exception to the other twelve fields, or infer operation N/A.
po_decision_material.impact: A represents both source clauses while preserving all 13 fields and change-operation controls; its non-applicability value exception is limited to NFR-28’s service/capability field. B leaves an explicit NFR-28 condition without a candidate destination. C postpones the semantic choice. This packet records choices; it does not create adoption, owner transfer, or new approval procedure.

Old HIL-NFR-28 explicitly permits reasoned non-applicability only for its service/capability binding; this permission does not generalize to other fields.

NFR-28 explicitly permits that value for service/capability, so keep this field and bind its value to reason, target scope/revision, authority/applicability basis. The two selected sources do not authorize generalizing non-applicability to the other twelve fields; preserve their required meaning and values unless separate explicit field-specific source evidence applies. No non-applicability value waives owner/source/oracle or related fields. Missing/unknown/stale/implicit omission remains incomplete. A requirement-change operation N/A is distinct and still needs its full FR-45 receipt.
